The '''hafa''' [[Vine/Legends|vine]] grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. It produced leaves and [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] that were an ingredient in the [[Cassandran choholl]] [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage and was considered a luxury [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. Its [[Farm/Legends|cultivation]] on Garqi was encouraged under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, and Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Chine Gabbard]] once tried to use [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] hafa pollen to carry [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve agents]].

==Biology and appearance==
Hafa was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Vine/Legends|vine]] that grew on [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran Worlds]]. The vine was considered a luxury [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" /> as its leaves and [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] were harvested and fermented for use as the basis of [[Cassandran choholl]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|6|Hafa}}</ref> a potent [[Alcohol/Legends|liquor]]<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" /> sought after throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> The [[Color/Legends|amber]] liquid was known for its fragrant, fruity vapors.<ref name="Missed">{{JournalCite|7|Missed Chance}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:ChineGabbard.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Chine Gabbard supposedly worked to improve the yield of hafa vines.]]
[[Farm/Legends|Cultivation]] of the hafa vine on Garqi was encouraged by the [[Procurator of Justice|Imperial Procurator]] after the planet and its fellow Cassandran Worlds were annexed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Chine Gabbard]], an Imperial [[Botanist/Legends|botanist]] who also worked for the agricultural corporation [[Rehemsa Consumables]], worked at [[Garqi Agricultural University]], ostensibly trying to improve the crop yield of hafa vines. The project garnered much attention; however, few knew that Gabbard was actually working for the Empire, trying to create a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] from hafa vines suitable for use on Imperial black ops missions. [[Gender/Legends|His]] work involved [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] hafa pollen to carry [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve agents]], and he was close to recommending that the Empire seize Garqi and turn it into a mass manufacturing center for his bioweapon.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" />

{{RPGseed}}
Downwind from [[Chine Gabbard's research station|Gabbard's research station]] was the [[Vlassy Nature Preserve]], home to [[rdava-bird]]s. Hafa pollen loaded with the nerve agent from Gabbard's experiments escaped his facility and [[Death/Legends|killed]] off significant numbers of the [[Bird/Legends|birds]] along with several [[Biologist/Legends|biologists]] who tried to investigate the avian deaths. Prior to the biologists' deaths, a group of [[operative]]s they had hired began to be affected by the nerve agent as well, but not before the agents broke into Gabbard's facility and obtained the antidote.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The hafa was created for ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a [[2004]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" />
